messages:
alyssa: PR #4302 blocked: snippet asserts X-Model-Fallback header on a streaming request. CI preview failed. Anyone confirm runtime behavior? @kevin @dave
docs-ci-bot: preview build failed -> snippet-test -> /site/snippets/model-fallback.md:line 18 -> expected header
kevin: Runtime used to put X-Model-Fallback on final response only for non-stream. For stream we emit an in-stream control event (event:model.swap). I thought we documented that but maybe it's scattered. @runtime-bot?
runtime-bot: runtime note: streaming responses send control events as JSON chunks (model.swap) when a swap occurs. No final header is set unless response_mode!=stream.
dave: Confirmed. We avoid buffering to keep latency low.
alyssa: Ok. Tests assume header so we should update snippet to show how to read control events from stream. Is that OK for docs?
kevin: Yes, show both cases: non-stream (header) and stream (control event). Add a short explanation about latency tradeoff.
dave: Also add a note: customers on Dedicated with response proxy may see header if proxy buffers. But runtime team won't rely on that.
alyssa: Will update PR with two minimal examples and explanatory note, rerun CI. Thanks.
docs-ci-bot: rebuild queued for PR #4302
docs-ci-bot: preview build passed  snippets OK
alyssa: merging after green. Thanks all :rocket:
